components.usage: Pass options as value and label pairs. The live shell uses 36px. The face is white. Quiet outline is 1px Infra Grey B. Do not leave the fill empty on canvas. Caption can sit above the control. Form rows on Profile keep the label above the control. Discipline, role, the date window, Total or Individual consumption, cost, or carbon, and Bar or Line for graph style use this. Total consumption is how much the group used. Individual consumption is which sites or meters made that usage. Total is the first view. Individual, Hours, Breakdown, and Analyse add detail. Do not open on a wall of everything. A note under the option name makes that split. Pick people on Add a team. That Select can take more than one. Search people sits in the list. The list shows five rows. Then it scrolls. Ticks.

Do not draw 365 daily bars. That waits on a test. Custom uses the from and to. A single day is Sun 7 Dec 2025. Short weekday, then the date. The graph heading uses the same words. Custom opens a calendar. Graph arrows also set Custom. Back at the original window it is the preset again. Do not use a native dropdown. The chevron sits on the right. The face is white. Quiet outline is 1px Infra Grey B. Do not leave the fill empty on canvas. Future days are on. Renew access does not use this calendar. Start and End are dd/mm/yyyy. They type from the left.

components.name: Filter
components.summary: An icon button that opens an overlay with ticks. The count is a cyan circle. No black rim. When a filter is on, pills sit under the control. Electricity, Gas, and Water sit with those marks. In and Out sit with the import and export marks. A cross clears that one. Clear takes them all off.
components.usage: The parent holds the ticks. Each group has All. All ticks every child. If a child is off, All is mixed. Tree Filter sits to the right of Search. The pane uses the same control to the right of Compare. Compare uses it next to Search in the modal. Sort sits in that overlay. Leave the modal and Search and Filter start again. Name, Needs action, and Sites or Meters. Ownership is Tenant owned. Meter is Electricity, Gas, and Water. Incoming and Outgoing. The ticks say In and Out. In and Out start on, same as the graph. Electricity and Gas start on when they are on the graph. Water is off until they tick it. Walk sites hold a water meter so the tick has a hit. Dummy site A1 still holds one. Serial then the number. Dummy site A1 and A2 are tenant owned so the tick has a hit. Do not invent ownership on Network Rail. The pane Filter also has Hours and Time of use. Hours is Operational, Non-operational, and Closed. Operational is trading or working. Non-operational is people may be there, preparing or maintaining, not trading. Closed is shut, no normal activity. Time of use is On peak and Off peak. Those ticks cross Hours. Do not split Peak and Off-peak from Operational, Non-operational, and Closed. The graph and Breakdown use Operational · Peak, Operational · Off-peak, Non-operational · Peak, Non-operational · Off-peak, Closed · Peak, and Closed · Off-peak. Those ticks stack in the bars, so you can see how and where each one lies. A key under the graph uses the same on and off pills as In and Out. Click to take a slice off. Off pills strike through the name. They can take the last one off. They also cut Breakdown. The tree does not have Hours or Time of use. Odd use, Missing data, and Not sending stay on Alerts. Downloads uses it next to Search. Kind is CSV and PDF. Type is Report and Data export. Status is Processing.

props.note: How many ticks are on. Hide the chip at zero.

components.usage: Put a heading and one action inside. Do not nest cards. The card is the hit target on Home. Report Live, Waiting, and Custom sit in Tag. On the alert card the word is Unread or Resolved. The title is a heading. Resolved sits in the filters at the top of the Alerts list. On a group or a site the Alerts tab is unread. The resolved card stays white. Investigate becomes View alert. After resolve, Undo puts it back. Queries sits the list in a card.

components.usage: Pass items. Do not fetch inside the list. Empty uses Empty. Compare rows are the name and the meter count. Hover the count for the MPAN. It waits 0.7 seconds.

components.name: Table
components.summary: Dense lists of meters, sites, and readings. Body type is black. Headers use Infra Grey C on white. The State column uses State pills. Breakdown In and Out are text headings.
components.usage: Pass columns and rows. Do not fetch inside the table. The pane scrolls the interval table. On a group or All, the site list sits in Breakdown. The graph stays the same height. Total, Individual, Bar, Line, Hours, and filter pills do not change it. Do not give Breakdown its own scrollbar. Rows load as they scroll. Click a meter row to open it. Click it again to hide it. Opening one closes the others. Empty uses Empty. Queries sits the list in a card. Column headers sort. A pair of arrows sits in the header. Click for A to Z or lowest first. Click again to reverse. Words are alphabetical. Numbers and dates go lowest to highest, then the reverse. Resolve and other actions do not sort.

components.name: Tag
components.summary: A quiet pill for a short fact. Live, Waiting, Custom, role, discipline, Expiry on Users, Complete on Downloads, Type on Downloads, and a label on a graph reading. No status colour. Report tags explain on hover.
components.usage: Keep to one or two words. Do not add a green or red fill for status. Meter health uses State, not Tag. Hover on a report tag. Live is People are sent this report. Waiting is This report is not in yet. You cannot run it. Custom is A name only. You cannot run it yet. On Users, Expiry is how long is left. Years if more than 12 months. Months if a month or more. Days if under a month. On Downloads, Complete is the file is ready. Type is Report or Data export. Report is black on cyan. Data export is white on black. On a graph point, tags sit as Tag pills. Each name gets an assigned colour from the IBM Carbon categorical set. That name keeps the colour. Type is black or white for contrast. Not a status colour. A tag stays on that reading when they leave and come back. Peak, On peak, and Out of hours are Time of use, not tags. Do not put tags in Settings. Do not pick a tag to list every reading. Reports on tagged data wait.

components.name: State
components.summary: Meter health in a coloured pill. Odd use and Not sending use the warning wash. Missing data uses the danger wash. Sending uses the success wash. Odd use, Missing data, and Not sending have a warning. Sending has a tick. On a group or compare head, one pill says how many alerts.
components.usage: Use on the State column. Group and compare heads use one pill with the alert count. Do not use a silent mark. Missing data is light red with darker red type and mark. Odd use and Not sending are light amber with darker amber type and mark. Sending is light green with darker green type and mark. Tag is for Live, Waiting, Custom, role, and Expiry on Users. Query list status stays Open, Expected, Fixed, or Duplicate.

components.name: Flow pill
components.summary: One pill. In and Out use Icon Incoming or Outgoing. A meter series hides the icon and shows the colour mark. Off strikes through the name. The live shell is 24px.
components.usage: Use on the meter row, the graph key, and the query pin. Incoming and Outgoing stay the words on the site. Import and export stay the stored channel. On the key, click In or Out to take that series off. Click it again to put it back. Off pills strike through the name. They can take the last one off. A meter series uses this same pill: hide the icon and show the colour mark. Breakdown In and Out are text headings. Do not make those pills.

props.name: kind
props.note: In is incoming. Out is outgoing.

components.summary: A cyan circle with black type. No black rim. Filter uses 18px on the icon. Compare uses 22px inside the ghost button.
components.usage: Show how many filters or compared items are on. Hide it at zero. Do not put a black rim on the circle.

components.name: Meter pill
components.summary: Same pill as Flow pill. Hide the icon and show the colour mark. Colour on the mark matches the series on the graph. Off pills strike through the name.
components.usage: On a group, each pill is a site. On a site, each pill is a meter. A site with one meter still shows the pill. Click to take it off. Click again to put it back. One line. The name stays on one line. Every pill that fits on the line stays whole. The rest sit in Show x more. Show x more uses the same type as the pill. Hide puts them away. Incoming is cyan. Outgoing is black. Compare and Individual consumption use the line colours. The first is the secondary. Then IBM Carbon categorical colours, in their order. Actual is a solid line. A dotted line is estimated. Do not put All, In, or Out chips on the site head.

props.name: color
props.note: Matches the series on the graph.

props.note: Puts the series on the graph or takes it off.

components.summary: There is no StatusBadge file in the product. Meter health uses State. Live, Waiting, Custom, role, and Expiry use Tag.

sections.title: Overview
sections.summary: IMSERV company brand, not a UI kit
sections.short: IMSERV makes energy's toughest problems simple. Astral is the product. This book is company brand, not a UI kit. James owns product screens. Camilla holds Brand Hub.
sections.body: The copied file is IMSERV Brand Book. Pony.studio made it. IMSERV is the data-driven partner that makes energy's toughest problems simple. The public line is the leader in energy data intelligence, from field to insight. Astral is the product. James still owns product screens. Camilla still holds Brand Hub and the original brand file. A premium customer may rebrand the portal later. Clive decides.

sections.title: Logo
sections.short: Wordmark plus the M wave. Four colourways. Cyan or white on black first. Keep 22px high. Do not stretch, skew, or redraw it. This is not the Astral product mark.
sections.body: The IMSERV logo is the company mark. The full lockup pairs the wordmark with the flowing M wave. The M wave can stand alone as the logomark. Four colourways are approved. Cyan on black, white on black, black on cyan, and black on white. Recommended pairings put cyan or white on black. Minimum height is 22px. Keep clear space. Do not stretch, skew, or redraw it. On photos use the one-colour light mark, not the two-colour version. Official files come from the brand book. Check Marketing and Brand before you use them. sections.short: IMSERV Cyan highlights. Infra Grey structures. Black and white carry the work. Cyan on white fails. Extra Cyan 2 is the Astral fill, with white type. Print is Pantone 3252 C.
sections.body: Primary is IMSERV Cyan at #03F4E8. Supportive greys are Infra Grey A #EFEFEF, B #DFDFDF, and C #737373. Core is black and white. Cyan highlights, identifies, and guides. Grey gives structure on technical layouts. Black and white carry dashboards and wayfinding. Extra Cyan 1 #02C2B7 and Extra Cyan 2 #028178 exist for depth. Print specifies Pantone 3252 C. Pair type as black on white, white on black, or cyan on black. Black on cyan also meets AA. Cyan on white fails. Infra Grey C meets AA on white and fails on Infra Grey A. Status colours are not in this book. Do not invent a green or red. Astral secondary is Extra Cyan 2 #028178. Pair it with white type. Do not treat the Brand Book hex as the product fill.
notes: Keep IMSERV Cyan as the dominant company brand colour. Astral secondary is Extra Cyan 2.
James mocked an Octopus skin. Clive still has to say if a customer picks a skin.
WCAG AA needs 4.5 to 1 for type and 3 to 1 for control edges. Cyan on white fails, so Extra Cyan 2 is the rim on cyan pills. That keeps a cyan family without a black box.

sections.title: Type
sections.short: Roobert Medium is the voice. Semibold is for small labels. Skip Regular. Aptos only if Roobert is missing. Stay left aligned.
sections.body: Roobert is the IMSERV typeface. Medium is the primary weight for headlines and body. Semibold is for small labels and short highlights. Regular is not part of the core system. Headlines use Medium at a clearly larger size. Body stays Medium and changes size, not weight, for secondary copy. Skip a weight and double the size when pairing. Stay left aligned. Where Roobert is missing, Aptos Regular is the named fallback, with Aptos Semibold only if you must. Teams buy their own Roobert licence. The desk and Prototype load Roobert from this machine. sections.title: Voice
sections.summary: Direct, proactive, grounded, human with an edge
sections.short: Direct. Proactive. Grounded in data. Human, with an edge. No jargon. No waffle. Tone flexes. Voice stays.
sections.body: The voice stays consistent. Tone flexes. More direct in a fault report. More conversational in a welcome. Four traits sit in the book. Direct, clear, uncomplicated. Proactive and problem-solving. Grounded in data and know-how. Human, with an edge. No jargon. No waffle. No corporate filler. Personality is we make the complex simple, with sharper tech, smarter data, and people who do not give up.
notes: Avoid lines like seamless end-to-end optimisation or we apologise for any inconvenience caused.

Field work, meters, vans, and sites sit next to people. On the website and in presentations, keep photography refined. Level 1 is simple lines and patterns. They bring consistency and motion across touchpoints. From presentations to digital they give a sense of clarity, precision, and forward movement. entries.note: The type of meter. A flame sits next to the MPRN. It is not the water drop.
entries.from: Shaun on the site meter, 5 Sep

entries.name: Water
entries.avoid: Utilities. Water (m³). Water (L).
entries.note: A Filter tick under Meter. Off until they tick it. Walk sites hold a water meter so the tick has a hit. Dummy site A1 still holds one. Serial then the number. The mark is a drop, not a flame. Consumption is m³. Cost is £. Carbon is kgCO2e. Combined carbon uses the 2026 supply and wastewater factors, with 95 percent return-to-sewer. On Consumption, water cannot share a graph with electricity or gas. The notice says this combination cannot be shown. Water is cubic metres. Electricity and gas are kilowatt hours. View water consumption ticks Water and takes Electricity and Gas off. View electricity & gas consumption ticks those and takes Water off. Cost and Carbon can share. Do not invent a SPID. Tree icons still wait.
entries.from: Shaun on the pane Filter, 22 Sep

entries.name: Group
entries.avoid: Folder. Region. Area. Team as this object.
entries.note: One level above a site in the tree. Network Rail holds the sites. Click it for a collective overview. Opening one group closes the others. Click it again to hide the sites. All sits at the top of the tree. Click it for a collective overview. Group membership can also decide which sites, MPANs, reports, and documents a person sees. An MPAN can sit in more than one group. Do not treat this as a Team on Users. Permission user groups stay in admin. The final model is still open.
entries.from: Portfolio tree, 5 Sep, and handoff model, 22 Sep

entries.name: All
entries.avoid: Portfolio. Entire estate.
entries.note: Sits at the top of the tree. Click it for a collective overview of the sites in the list. No chevron. Tenanted retail stays in that overview because it sits in the tree. This is not the All chip on the graph.
entries.from: Shaun on the Portfolio tree, 8 Sep

entries.name: Reading
entries.note: A value from a meter. It can be actual or estimated.

entries.name: Actual
entries.note: A real reading, not a guess.

entries.name: Estimated
entries.avoid: Using the same mark as Alert.
entries.note: A reading that was guessed. Confidence, not attention. Do not use the Alert pattern. On the graph the bar uses a quiet fill of the same colour, not a hatch. On a line the stretch is dotted. Actual is a solid line.
entries.from: Talks and UAT walkthroughs, and handoff model, 22 Sep

entries.name: Missing data
entries.avoid: Gaps, as a filter label.
entries.note: A hole in the interval. Not zero use. Shaun said Gaps did not make sense as a user. Do not use a silent mark. On State it sits in a pill with a warning.

entries.name: Not sending
entries.avoid: Stale, as a filter label.
entries.note: The last actual is old. Home already says meters still sending actuals. Do not use a silent mark. On State it sits in a pill with a warning.

entries.name: Odd use
entries.avoid: Alerts, as a filter on the Alerts page.
entries.note: Demand that looks wrong. Out of pattern, before it hits a bill. Do not use a silent mark, and not Alert. On State it sits in a pill with a warning.

entries.name: Sending
entries.note: The meter is fine. On State it sits in a pill with a tick.

entries.name: State
entries.avoid: Mixing State with Tag. StatusBadge as a product file.
entries.note: Meter health sits in State pills. Odd use, Missing data, and Not sending have a warning. Sending has a tick. Missing data is light red with darker red type and mark. Odd use and Not sending are light amber with darker amber type and mark. Sending is light green with darker green type and mark. On a group or compare head, one pill says how many alerts. Tag is for Live, Waiting, Custom, role, and Expiry on Users. There is no StatusBadge file.
entries.from: Prototype review, 6 Sep, and Shaun on StatusBadge, 23 Sep

entries.name: StatusBadge
entries.avoid: StatusBadge as a product file.
entries.note: There is no StatusBadge in the product. Meter health uses State. Live, Waiting, Custom, role, and Expiry use Tag. Do not add a generic success, warning, danger, or info badge.

entries.name: Consumption
entries.avoid: Interval, as a tab label.
entries.note: The use graph on a group or a site. The graph has this title when Incoming sits alone. Incoming and Outgoing stay on this tab. Cost and Carbon sit next to it. The unit follows the meter. Electricity and gas are kWh. Water is m³. They cannot share this graph. The notice says this combination cannot be shown. View water consumption ticks Water. View electricity & gas consumption ticks Electricity and Gas. Cost and Carbon can share.
entries.from: Prototype review, 5 Sep, and Shaun on mixed units, 23 Sep

entries.name: This combination cannot be shown
entries.avoid: Tick one kind so they do not share this graph. A blank chart with no reason. You cannot compare water consumption (m³) with electricity and gas (kWh).
entries.note: On Consumption when Water is on with Electricity or Gas. The body says water is cubic metres and electricity and gas are kilowatt hours. They cannot share this graph. The two actions set the Meter ticks. Cost and Carbon can keep all three.

entries.name: View electricity & gas consumption
entries.avoid: View kilowatt hours. View kWh. Show electricity.
entries.note: On Consumption when water is on with electricity or gas. Ticks Electricity and Gas and takes Water off. Cost and Carbon can keep all three.

entries.name: View water consumption
entries.avoid: View cubic metres. View m³. View meters cubed.
entries.note: On Consumption when water is on with electricity or gas. Ticks Water and takes Electricity and Gas off. Cost and Carbon can keep all three.

entries.name: Cost
entries.avoid: Spend as the tab.
entries.note: The spend graph on a group or a site. Same window as Consumption. Unit is pounds for electricity, gas, and water. Rates on Site profile feed the walk numbers. Incoming and Outgoing stay as In and Out.
entries.from: Shaun on Cost and Carbon, 11 Sep

entries.name: Carbon
entries.avoid: Emissions as the tab. CO2 as the tab.
entries.note: The carbon graph on a group or a site. Same window as Consumption. Unit is kgCO2e. Walk numbers. Electricity and gas still use a dummy factor. Water uses the 2026 supply and wastewater factors, combined on the graph.
entries.from: Shaun on Cost and Carbon, 11 Sep

entries.name: View alerts
entries.note: In the nav Notifications list it opens Alerts. The Alerts tab holds the count. Do not put this line on Consumption.

entries.name: Notifications
entries.note: An icon in the nav, left of ME. Opens unread alerts. View alerts sits under the list. The count is a cyan circle. No black rim. Do not invent a Notifications page.

entries.name: Hide
entries.avoid: Dismiss
entries.note: On Export processing, Hide puts that banner away. Downloads is a subpage from Reports. Reports and Downloads sit as Tabs under Reports and compliance. The selected tab is a black pill. The pill slides. Do not put a ghost Downloads or Reports button in the page actions. On the graph pills, Hide puts the extra line away.

entries.name: Show more
entries.avoid: Show all
entries.note: On the graph pills. The number is how many sit off the first line. Hide puts them away.

entries.name: Expand
entries.note: On the Prototype preview bar. The hidden bar is this icon. Hover for the action. It waits 0.7 seconds.

entries.name: Flow
entries.avoid: Prototype preview as the bar title
entries.note: The label on the Prototype preview bar next to the Flow Select. Main product is the default so they do not walk sign in to see the product.

entries.name: Main product
entries.note: The default Flow on the Prototype preview bar. The live Astral shell.

entries.name: Onboarding
entries.note: A Flow on the Prototype preview bar. Name, discipline, job title, and a picture. Save changes puts them in the product. Contact still waits.

entries.name: Sign-up
entries.avoid: Login
entries.note: A Flow on the Prototype preview bar. Name, email, company, and password. Check your email takes a six-digit code, then Onboarding. Don't have an account on Sign in opens this. Do not put Already have an account or Sign in on this card. Do not store the password or the code.

entries.name: Password recovery
entries.avoid: Forgot password as the Flow name
entries.note: A Flow on the Prototype preview bar. Forgot password sits under the password on Sign in. Reset your password uses Email address, then Send reset link. Check your email takes a six-digit code, then Create a new password. Do not store the password or the code. Auth screens are a centred card with no product nav.

entries.name: Invite link
entries.note: A Flow on the Prototype preview bar. The join from Users. You've been invited, then Join the team. Review shows who invited them, the team, the role, and the email. Accept invite creates an account. Already have an account goes to Sign in with the email locked. Forgot password from there keeps that email locked and comes back to Sign in to join. You're in, then Go to the team. Do not put expired, already joined, or wrong account walk links on the review. Do not store a password. Same centred card as Sign in and Password recovery.

entries.name: Compare
entries.note: Opens a modal of others at the same level. Search and add more than one. A Filter sits to the right of Search. Overlay uses ticks. Same Ownership, Meter, and Incoming and Outgoing as the tree. Sort is Name, Needs action, and Sites or Meters. The row is the name and the meter count. Hover the count for the MPAN. It waits 0.7 seconds. On one meter, Compare lists other meters throughout the portfolio. The row is the site and the MPAN. Odd use, Missing data, and Not sending stay on Alerts.

entries.name: Clear
entries.avoid: A second Clear ghost next to Compare
entries.note: The cross on the Compare count. Drops the comparison and returns to the group or site you were on.

entries.name: Last year
entries.avoid: Last period
entries.note: Home use against last year. Last period does not say which window. The figure is whether they are using more than they were. Finance is highest spend.

entries.name: Finance
entries.avoid: Energy as this navbar item
entries.note: A navbar for people who need highest spend, why it is high, and where they can cut. The list is the top 5 incoming spend last 24 hours. Reports is the file they send back. Odd use sits on Alerts. Invoices still wait. Finance stays off for Platform admin, Broker / TPI, and Supplier.

entries.name: Highest spend
entries.avoid: Top spenders, listing the whole estate
entries.note: The Finance table. Top 5 incoming last 24 hours. Dummy sites stay off. The muted line is Top 5. Incoming last 24 hours. The card fills to the bottom. It does not scroll.

entries.name: Area
entries.avoid: Floor area as the field name.
entries.note: A named attribute on the MPAN. The unit is m². The number is editable. The unit sits grey next to it.

entries.name: Channel
entries.note: Channel level data is closer to Meterpower and EDV1 than to DataVision. You have Meterpower.

entries.name: Stacked label
entries.note: A short name sits above the value in the field. Lock the real labels after UAT.

entries.name: Action verbs
entries.note: Desk previews use short verbs. Confirm the live set on UAT before they ship.

entries.name: No meters
entries.note: A preview line with one action. Confirm on UAT before it ships.

entries.name: Field needed
entries.say: Say which site this meter belongs to.
entries.note: Error is a sentence, not a colour. Do not invent a red.

entries.name: Widget help
entries.note: James will cover this Monday. One framework for a modal, a title, and a help icon. Own the line once those slots exist.

entries.name: Log in as user
entries.avoid: Impersonate
entries.note: Super admin only. Sits on the person in Users, not buried in Actions. It shows the portal as that person. Back to admin gets them out. Admin and Manager do not get this.

entries.name: Back to admin
entries.avoid: Using Log out when you mean switch account.
entries.note: The way back after Log in as user, or after picking Network Rail. A bar under the product chrome. Log out still leaves the session.

entries.name: Log out
entries.avoid: Using Log out when you mean switch account.
entries.note: Leaves the session. Do not use it to get back to admin. Back to admin is the way back.

entries.name: Actions
entries.note: A menu on the user row. Withdraw sits there. Log in as user sits on the person for Super admin.

entries.name: Companies
entries.note: Companies is the list. Pick a company to see their product. Overview is the picture for the platform. Add a company sits on Companies. Type is Customer, Supplier, or Broker / TPI.

entries.name: Brokers
entries.note: An admin side item next to companies and users.

entries.name: Users
entries.note: An admin side item. All users, then Actions on a row.

entries.name: TMA
entries.avoid: Talking about TMA and Meterpower as two different products.
entries.note: Meterpower is the public face of TMA. People say TMA for the same thing.

entries.name: Meterpower
entries.note: The public face of TMA. More granular than DataVision. Astral has to replace it.

entries.name: User login error
entries.say: User login error. Please try again later.
entries.note: Mailtrap. A persistent bug. Not a password mistake. Push it to Dev.

entries.name: Multi-tenancy
entries.avoid: Building all of it into the December screens.
entries.note: Label the foundations. Do not build the tenancy now. Clive wants January to land on those blocks.

entries.name: PrimeNG
entries.avoid: Copying Prime colour or type into the IMSERV library.
entries.note: The live tree and other controls. James and Alexi chose it over Material. React may use PrimeReact. James walks it Monday.

entries.name: Import
entries.avoid: Incoming supply · Import on the chip.
entries.note: Power entering the site. Max said import and consumption are the same thing. DataVision still stores Import. On the screens the pill says In.

entries.name: Export
entries.avoid: Export · Export on the chip. A minus sign on the number.
entries.note: Power leaving the site to the grid. DataVision still stores Export. On the screens the pill says Out.

entries.name: Incoming
entries.avoid: Incoming supply · Import on the chip.
entries.note: On the screens a pill. An import mark. In is cyan. Import stays the stored channel. The graph title stays Incoming and outgoing.
entries.from: Shaun on the site chips, 4 Sep

entries.name: Outgoing
entries.avoid: Export · Export on the chip. A minus on the number.
entries.note: On the screens a pill. An export mark. Out is black. Export stays the stored channel. The number stays positive. The graph title stays Incoming and outgoing.
entries.from: Shaun on the site chips, 4 Sep

entries.name: Breakdown
entries.note: The interval table sits in Breakdown. Closed until they open it. Time is UTC. Local time waits as a table option. Click a row to highlight that time on the graph. On a group or All, the site list sits in Breakdown. The graph stays the same height. Total, Individual, Bar, Line, Hours, and filter pills do not change it. The pane scrolls it. Do not give Breakdown its own scrollbar. Rows load as they scroll. In and Out are text headings, same as Time. When Hours or Time of use ticks are on, Operational · Peak, Operational · Off-peak, Non-operational · Peak, Non-operational · Off-peak, Closed · Peak, and Closed · Off-peak sit as text headings, same as Time. Do not make them pills. Do not split Peak and Off-peak from the operating state. Breakdown follows the pills that are on.
entries.from: Shaun on the site pane, 6 Sep

entries.name: All
entries.avoid: Adding incoming and outgoing into one use number.
entries.note: Do not put All on the site head or the group head. Both meter pills on shows Incoming and Outgoing together. On a group they sit together when both exist. They stay separate series. The graph title is Incoming and outgoing. A visual key sits under the graph. In and Out sit in pills. An import mark on In. An export mark on Out. In is cyan. Out is black. A 24px gap sits under the key before Breakdown. Click In or Out to take that series off. Click it again to put it back. Off pills strike through the name. They can take the last one off. The graph sits empty. A black circle sits above the tallest bar in that time when it has a query or a comment. A black star sits above the tallest bar in that time when it has an alert. Incoming and Outgoing at one time are one hit. Query and alert on the same section stack. The circle sits closer to the bar. The star sits above. On Individual consumption the mark sits on the point, same as hover. Colour matches the line. A star replaces a circle if that point has an alert. A query raised on a site still marks that site on the group graph. Hourly queries and alerts sit on today when the window is days or months. Do not put Query or Alert in the key.

entries.name: Query
entries.note: On the graph, not in the key. A black circle sits above the tallest bar in that time when it has a query or a comment. Incoming and Outgoing at one time are one hit. Query and alert on the same section stack. The circle sits closer to the bar. The star sits above. On Individual consumption the mark sits on the point, same as hover. Colour matches the line. A star replaces a circle if that point has an alert. A query raised on a site still marks that site on the group graph. Hourly queries and alerts sit on today when the window is days or months.
entries.from: Shaun on the graph key, 6 Sep

entries.name: Alert
entries.avoid: Estimated. Query. Putting Alert in the key.
entries.note: On the graph, not in the key. A black star sits above the tallest bar in that time when it has an alert. Incoming and Outgoing at one time are one hit. Query and alert on the same section stack. The circle sits closer to the bar. The star sits above. On Individual consumption the mark sits on the point, same as hover. Colour matches the line. A star replaces a circle if that point has an alert. A query raised on a site still marks that site on the group graph. Hourly queries and alerts sit on today when the window is days or months. Alert is attention. Estimated is a guessed reading. Do not use the same mark.
entries.from: Shaun on the graph key, 6 Sep, and handoff model, 22 Sep

entries.name: All
entries.avoid: All on the meter Select
entries.note: Do not put a meter Select on the site head. Pills sit on the site. Each pill is a meter. Colour on the pill matches the series on the graph. Off pills strike through the name. A site with one meter still shows the pill. Click a pill to take that meter off the graph. Click it again to put it back. They can take the last one off. The graph sits empty. Alerts, Queries, Site profile, Cost, Carbon, and Breakdown on this pane follow the pills that are on. On a group, each pill is a site. Click a pill to take that site off the graph. Click it again to put it back. Do not put All, In, or Out chips on the site head or the group head. Incoming and Outgoing on one site use cyan and black, same as the graph. Compare or three or more meters use the line colours. The first is the secondary. Then IBM Carbon categorical colours, in their order, so neighbouring lines stay distinct. Skip Carbon cyan and near-black so they do not collide with Incoming or Outgoing. Actual is a solid line. A dotted line is estimated.
entries.from: Shaun on meter line colours, 6 Sep

entries.name: Filter
entries.note: Icon to the right of Search site or meter. The same Filter sits on the pane, to the right of Compare. The tree Filter works on the tree. The pane Filter works on the pane. Meter ticks on the tree also cut the graph and Site profile until the pane has its own meter ticks. Overlay with ticks. Each group has All. All ticks every child. If a child is off, All is mixed. Ownership is Tenant owned. Meter is Electricity, Gas, and Water. Incoming and Outgoing. The ticks say In and Out. In and Out start on, same as the graph. Electricity and Gas start on when they are on the graph. Water is off until they tick it. Walk sites hold a water meter so the tick has a hit. Dummy site A1 still holds one. Serial then the number. Dummy site A1 and A2 are tenant owned so the tick has a hit. Do not invent ownership on Network Rail. The pane Filter also has Hours and Time of use. Hours is Operational, Non-operational, and Closed. Operational is trading or working. Non-operational is people may be there, preparing or maintaining, not trading. Closed is shut, no normal activity. Time of use is On peak and Off peak. Those ticks cross Hours. Do not split Peak and Off-peak from Operational, Non-operational, and Closed. The graph and Breakdown use Operational · Peak, Operational · Off-peak, Non-operational · Peak, Non-operational · Off-peak, Closed · Peak, and Closed · Off-peak. Those ticks stack in the bars, so you can see how and where each one lies. A key under the graph uses the same on and off pills as In and Out. Click to take a slice off. Off pills strike through the name. They can take the last one off. They also cut Breakdown. The tree does not have Hours or Time of use. On Consumption, water cannot share a graph with electricity or gas. The notice says this combination cannot be shown. View water consumption ticks Water and takes Electricity and Gas off. View electricity & gas consumption ticks those and takes Water off. Cost and Carbon can share. Odd use, Missing data, and Not sending stay on Alerts. When a tree filter is on, pills sit under Search and Filter. When a pane filter is on, pills sit under the pane tools. A cross clears that one. Clear takes them all off. The Filter button shows how many are on. The count is a cyan circle. No black rim. Compare uses the same control next to Search. Sort sits in that overlay. Leave the modal and Search and Filter start again. Name, Needs action, and Sites or Meters. Downloads uses it next to Search. Kind is CSV and PDF. Type is Report and Data export. Status is Processing.
entries.from: Shaun on the tree filter, 6 Sep, and Max on interval filters, 22 Sep

entries.name: All
entries.avoid: Select all as the tick. Putting All on the site head or the group head.
entries.note: On a Filter group. All ticks every child in that group. If a child is off, All is mixed. Click All again to take the children off. Hours All puts Operational, Non-operational, and Closed on, so the graph can show the combined tariff breakdown.
entries.from: Select all in filter groups, 23 Sep

entries.name: Tenant owned
entries.avoid: All tenant owned properties, as the tick.
entries.note: A Filter tick under Ownership. Dummy site A1 and A2 are tenant owned so the tick has a hit. Do not invent ownership on Network Rail. Odd use, Missing data, and Not sending stay on Alerts.
entries.from: Shaun on the pane Filter, 8 Sep

entries.name: Total consumption
entries.note: The combined total for the selected group or sites at each time. How much this group used. This is the first view. A Select sits on the graph, to the left of the arrows. A note under the name makes the question. Next to it is the graph style. Bar or Line. Do not stack sites or meters on Total. Incoming and Outgoing stay cyan and black bars. On Line, one line for the total. Incoming and Outgoing become two lines, cyan and black. Colour matches the pills when the series are broken down. Cost uses Total cost. Carbon uses Total carbon. Compare can use Total.
entries.from: Shaun on the graph filter, 6 Sep

entries.name: Individual consumption
entries.avoid: Opening on Individual. A wall of everything.
entries.note: The sites or meters that made that total. Which sites made that usage, or which meters or MPANs on a site. Not the first view. They pick it when they want the parts. A note under the name makes the question. On a group, one series per site. On a site, one series per meter. The graph style Select next to it is Bar or Line. On Line, actual is a solid line. A dotted line is estimated. Estimated has no point mark unless that time has a query or an alert. Gaps stay gaps. Cost uses Individual cost. Carbon uses Individual carbon. Compare can use this.
entries.from: Shaun on the graph filter, 6 Sep

entries.name: Total cost
entries.note: The combined total on Cost. How much this group spent. Same Selects as Total consumption. Bar or Line.
entries.from: Shaun on Cost and Carbon, 11 Sep

entries.name: Individual cost
entries.note: The sites or meters that made that cost. Same Selects as Individual consumption. Bar or Line.
entries.from: Shaun on Cost and Carbon, 11 Sep

entries.name: Total carbon
entries.note: The combined total on Carbon. Same Selects as Total consumption. Bar or Line.
entries.from: Shaun on Cost and Carbon, 11 Sep

entries.name: Individual carbon
entries.note: The sites or meters that made that carbon. Same Selects as Individual consumption. Bar or Line.
entries.from: Shaun on Cost and Carbon, 11 Sep

entries.name: Bar
entries.avoid: Bar chart. Histogram.
entries.note: A graph style. Sits next to Total or Individual. Total stacks the readings. Individual keeps one series per site or meter. More styles can sit in this list later.

entries.name: Line
entries.avoid: Line chart. Sparkline.
entries.note: A graph style. Sits next to Total or Individual. Total is one line, or two when Incoming and Outgoing sit together. Individual is one line per site or meter. Actual is a solid line. A dotted line is estimated.

entries.name: One meter on this site
entries.note: The meter Select is gone. A site with one meter still shows the pill. They can take it off. The graph sits empty.

entries.name: Last 24 hours
entries.avoid: Yesterday as the near preset.
entries.note: The near interval view. A rolling window, like Last 7 days. Gaps and not sending show up here first.
entries.from: Shaun on the site date filter, 5 Sep

entries.name: Last 7 days
entries.note: A site date preset. Shaun put it next to the download.
entries.from: Shaun on the site date filter, 4 Sep

entries.name: Last month
entries.avoid: Last 28 days
entries.note: A site date preset. A rolling month from this day last month to today. If today is 23 September, it is 23 August to 23 September. The number of days follows the calendar, so a longer month keeps the 29th, 30th, or 31st. Do not use a fixed 28 days.

entries.name: Last 12 months
entries.avoid: Last 365 days. 365 daily bars on this graph.
entries.note: A site date preset. Twelve monthly bars. Analyse opens a month, then a day. A year of daily bars waits on a test. Do not squeeze 365 bars onto the graph. Zoom, pan, or a different picture may be needed.
entries.from: Shaun on the site date filter, 4 Sep, and on a 365-day view, 23 Sep

entries.name: Custom
entries.avoid: A colon in the filled label. Custom in front of the dates. 365 daily bars.
entries.note: Opens a calendar for from and to. The filled chip is the from and to. A single day is Sun 7 Dec 2025. Short weekday, then the date. The graph heading uses the same words. Graph arrows also set Custom. Back at the original window the preset returns. A window longer than two months stays months. Do not switch that to 365 daily bars.
entries.from: Shaun on the site date filter, 4 Sep

entries.name: Interval reports
entries.note: Pick a subset, graph the interval data, export a file. This is where the work happens.

entries.name: Local time
entries.avoid: Putting local time on the graph. Deleting a duplicated local clock. Renaming a row at the cutover.
entries.note: Graph times stay UTC. Local time waits as a user preference, a table display option, or a report or export setting. Not a graph control. Daylight saving can show the same local clock twice. Keep both rows. Do not rename them or delete one.
entries.from: Max DataVision usability, 4 Sep, and Shaun on local time later, 23 Sep

entries.name: UTC
entries.avoid: GMT. A UTC or BST pick on the graph. BST as the default. Local time as a graph control.
entries.note: Graph times are UTC. The date sits next to the title, then UTC. It is a label, not a control. Hours and Time of use sit on those clocks. Do not put UTC or BST as a pick on the graph. Local time waits as a preference, a table option, or a report setting. Daylight saving can show the same local clock twice. Keep both rows.

entries.name: Time of use
entries.avoid: Red, amber, green. DUoS. RAG.
entries.note: When the meter is on peak or off peak. Hours is when the site is trading or working. Rates is the tariff name. The value is On peak and off peak. The same field can show different values per role. On the pane Filter, Time of use is On peak and Off peak. Those ticks cut with Hours, not as a view on their own. The graph and Breakdown use Operational · Peak, Operational · Off-peak, Non-operational · Peak, Non-operational · Off-peak, Closed · Peak, and Closed · Off-peak.
entries.from: Backlog call on times of use, 4 Sep, and Max on interval filters, 22 Sep

entries.name: Operational hours
entries.avoid: Opening hours as the field name.
entries.note: When the site is trading or working. Each day is Operational, Non-operational, or Closed. Operational is actively trading. Non-operational is people may be there, preparing or maintaining, but the site is not trading. Closed is shut, no normal activity. From and to are 00:00. Select profile fills a day from a named preset. On the pane Filter, Hours is Operational, Non-operational, and Closed. Those ticks cut with Time of use, not as a view on their own. The graph and Breakdown use Operational · Peak, Operational · Off-peak, Non-operational · Peak, Non-operational · Off-peak, Closed · Peak, and Closed · Off-peak.
entries.from: DataVision attributes, 22 Sep, Max on interval filters, 22 Sep, and site operating states, 23 Sep

entries.name: Operational
entries.avoid: Open as the state name.
entries.note: The site is actively trading or working. On the pane Filter and graph, Hours. Out of those hours on this day is Non-operational, not Closed.

entries.name: Non-operational
entries.avoid: Closed. Off. Inactive.
entries.note: People may be there, preparing or maintaining. The site is not actively trading. A day set to Non-operational, or out of hours on an Operational day. Do not call this Closed.

entries.name: Closed
entries.avoid: Non-operational. Off.
entries.note: The site is shut. No normal activity. A day set to Closed. Sunday on a weekday depot. Do not call this Non-operational.

entries.name: Select profile
entries.avoid: Template as the control name.
entries.note: A named preset on a day of operational hours or time of use. 24 hour, Weekday depot, Retail day, Non-operational, and Closed. Time of use is On peak and off peak, Weekday peak, and Night and day.

entries.name: Attributes
entries.avoid: Metadata. Properties.
entries.note: Named fields on the MPAN. Area m². Capacity kVA. Daily standing charge electricity, gas, and water in GBP. Emissions factor electricity and gas in kgCO2e per kWh. Number of employees, People. On-peak and off-peak unit cost electricity and gas in pence per kWh. Unit cost water in pence per m³. The number is editable. The unit sits grey next to it. Do not pick a currency.

entries.name: Site profile
entries.note: Facts on each MPAN. Tariffs change often. On a group or a site this is a tab. Meters sit in a list. The list uses the same lines as the other tables. No box around it. Click a row to open that meter. Click it again to hide it. Opening one closes the others. Hours, time of use, and attributes sit in the open row. Settings sits as a cog with the word Settings. It opens a page for that meter. Back sits to the left of the heading. It goes back to Site profile. Operational hours, Time of use, and Attributes sit as accordions on that page. They start closed. Opening one closes the others. Click it again to hide it. The electric, gas, or water mark sits on the meter row. MPAN or MPRN for electricity and gas. Serial for water. Do not invent a SPID. If Country is England, points below a site are MPANs. In and Out sit in pills with an import or export mark, same as the graph. Save changes waits until they change a line. Time of use is on peak and off peak. Select profile fills a day from a named preset. From and to are 00:00. A map shows the site. The map is square. It follows the meters on the graph. Area is m². Capacity is kVA. Daily standing charges are GBP. Emissions factors are kgCO2e per kWh. Number of employees uses People. On-peak and off-peak unit costs are pence per kWh. Unit cost water is pence per m³. The unit sits grey next to the number. Do not pick a currency. Brand and install wait. This is an input into analytics, not extra metadata. Without a rate, do not show £0. Say cost is unavailable until they add tariff information.
entries.from: Shaun on site profile cards, 5 Sep, handoff model, 22 Sep, and DataVision attributes, 22 Sep

entries.name: Exception report
entries.avoid: Calling it the same thing as a scheduled report.
entries.note: A value has been breached. Too high, too low, not enough. Send an email.

entries.name: Scheduled report
entries.avoid: Hiding it only under Alerts. Calling it My Documents. Calling it Export.
entries.note: A clockwork extract. You can also set it from Alerts. Max called that a misnomer. Keep this off the documents pile.
entries.from: Max DataVision usability, 4 Sep, and handoff model, 22 Sep

entries.name: My Documents
entries.avoid: Downloads. Reports. Export.
entries.note: Files IMSERV produced elsewhere and placed for the customer. Safer than email or file transfer. A documents-only login may arrive here. Keep this off Downloads. The screen still waits.

entries.name: Data provision
entries.avoid: Calling this the same as a scheduled report or an Export.
entries.note: The business service that gives customers data and report outputs. Historically email or file transfer. Some of those files land in My Documents.

entries.name: Product entitlement
entries.avoid: Permissions as this layer. Letting the customer pick the tier in version one.
entries.note: What the company bought. Version one is documents only or full Astral. The sold services decide. Later a contract may grant the function. Not a label on a screen yet.

entries.name: Manager
entries.avoid: Super user on the customer Users list.
entries.note: They can work in the product and add others to the team. They are not Admin. Sit on Customer or Supplier. Not Broker / TPI.

entries.name: Contributor
entries.avoid: Contributer. User as a role name.
entries.note: They can work in the product. They cannot add people. Sit on Customer or Supplier. Not Broker / TPI.

entries.name: Viewer
entries.note: They can look. They cannot invite, raise a query, resolve, run a report, or change Settings. Broker / TPI only gets this access.

entries.name: Billing
entries.avoid: Putting Billing on Platform admin, Supplier, Contributor, or Viewer.
entries.note: Settings nav for Customer Admin and Manager. Invoices still wait. Do not invent a bill list on this page.

entries.name: Upload logo
entries.note: The organisation mark on the portal. A transparent PNG or SVG. SVG is better. The mark turns black or white against the bar. It sits in the bar with Astral.

entries.name: Logo
entries.note: Settings Organisation. Sits above Upload logo. The mark on the bar.

entries.name: No logo yet
entries.note: The default Organisation preview is the IMSERV mark. This line waits if there is no mark at all.

entries.name: A transparent PNG or SVG
entries.say: A transparent PNG or SVG. SVG is better. The mark turns black or white against the bar.
entries.note: Under Upload logo. PNG is allowed. SVG stays sharper and follows the bar contrast.

entries.name: Use a transparent PNG or SVG
entries.say: Use a transparent PNG or SVG.
entries.note: If they pick a JPEG or another file.

entries.name: Primary colour
entries.note: Paints the bar. Starts as the black used to white label the site.

entries.name: Secondary colour
entries.note: The cyan on chips and the graph. Starts as Extra Cyan 2.

entries.name: Colours
entries.avoid: Colors
entries.note: Settings Organisation. Sits above Primary colour and Secondary colour.

entries.name: Restore defaults
entries.avoid: Use IMSERV colours
entries.note: Puts the bar, cyan, and mark back. Clears an uploaded logo.

entries.name: Upload picture
entries.note: A JPEG or PNG on Profile. It sits in ME. Empty ME stays white on cyan. A name puts initials there. On Onboarding the picture sits in a card.

entries.name: A JPEG or PNG
entries.say: A JPEG or PNG. It sits in ME. Empty ME stays white on cyan. A name puts initials there.
entries.note: On Profile, under Upload picture. Not on Onboarding. Do not take SVG. The empty mark is white type on cyan with no outline.

entries.name: Use a JPEG or PNG
entries.note: If they pick an SVG or another file.

entries.name: Name
entries.note: On Profile. It updates the initials in ME after Save changes. Empty ME stays ME, white on cyan.

entries.name: Discipline
entries.avoid: A native dropdown. Mixing this with Admin, Manager, Contributor, or Viewer. Putting Platform admin or Customer on this list.
entries.note: A Select on Profile and Onboarding. The chevron sits on the right. The list is Energy, Finance, Asset, and Data. Those are industry hats, not platform roles. Access and company type sit elsewhere.

entries.name: Pick a discipline
entries.note: The empty state on the Discipline Select.

entries.name: Job title
entries.note: A line on Profile. Their own words. Contact still waits. Name, discipline, and job title wait for Save changes.

entries.name: Email address
entries.avoid: Letting them change it.
entries.note: On Profile and on Invite link it is disabled. They cannot change it. Disabled is grey, not a faded colour. On Sign in, Sign-up, and Password recovery they type it. Contact still waits.

entries.name: Save changes
entries.avoid: Save
entries.note: On Profile. Name, discipline, and job title wait for it. Save changes waits until they change a line. Disabled Save changes is grey, not a faded colour. The picture still sits when they upload.

entries.name: Users
entries.avoid: Putting admin user groups on this screen.
entries.note: Where a company Admin or Manager adds people. Super admin, Admin, and Manager can group them into teams. Users sits in Settings. Companies and teams sit as accordions in the people card. Super admin sees a company, then its teams. This walk is Network Rail, Scottish Water, Tesco, and EDF. Admin and Manager see departments. Invite opens a modal. Role is Admin, Manager, Contributor, or Viewer on Customer and Supplier. Broker / TPI only gets Viewer. Super admin is only for Platform admin. Viewer can look. Do not put Astral on this list. Permission user groups stay in admin.

entries.name: Invite
entries.avoid: Invite users as a product name for the screen.
entries.note: The action on Users. Opens a modal. Email and a role.

entries.name: Add a team
entries.avoid: Add a user group.
entries.note: On Users. Opens a modal. Team name and company. Company is a pick when they can see other companies. Otherwise it sits disabled on their company. Disabled is grey, not a faded colour. Pick people in Select. Search people sits in that list. They can pick more than one. Super admin, Admin, and Manager can do it. Add a team sits to the left of Invite users. Super admin sees a company, then its teams. This walk is Network Rail, Scottish Water, Tesco, and EDF. Admin and Manager see departments.

entries.name: Add a company
entries.avoid: Third party as a company type on this modal.
entries.note: On Companies. Opens a modal. Company name and type. Type is Customer, Supplier, or Broker / TPI. Third-party access sits on the link to another customer. Super admin can do it. Add a team stays on Users.

entries.name: Team name
entries.avoid: Using Team as a Group on the tree.
entries.note: Required on Add a team. Add team waits until they type a name. Disabled is grey, not a faded colour. A Team is who they work with. Do not use this for which sites, MPANs, reports, or documents they can see.
entries.from: Shaun on Users teams, 7 Sep, and handoff model, 22 Sep

entries.name: Department
entries.note: Not on Add a team. A new team uses its name. Admin and Manager still see departments in the Users tree where a team already has one. Super admin sees companies, and teams for the same company sit together.

entries.name: Sign in
entries.avoid: Copying the IMSERV website Login.
entries.note: Puts you back in the portal after Log out. Also a Flow on the Prototype preview bar. Email address and password. Sign in waits until both are in. Disabled is grey, not a faded colour. Don't have an account and Sign-up sit under the line. Do not store the password. Mailtrap still blocks live sign in.

entries.name: Password
entries.avoid: Login
entries.note: On Sign in and Sign-up. Create a new password uses New password and Confirm password. Invite create uses Create password. Show and Hide sit on those fields. Do not store it.

entries.name: Forgot password?
entries.avoid: Password recovery as the Sign in link
entries.note: Under the password field on Sign in, above Sign in. On invite Sign in it sits under Sign in.

entries.name: Don't have an account?
entries.note: Under the line on Sign in, with Sign-up. Do not put Already have an account or Sign in on Sign-up.

entries.name: Reset your password
entries.note: The heading on the recovery form. Helper is Enter the email address linked to your account. CTA is Send reset link.

entries.name: Send reset link
entries.avoid: Send on this screen
entries.note: Waits until Email address is valid. Disabled is grey, not a faded colour.

entries.name: Back to sign in
entries.note: A text link with Previous. On Reset your password. Do not put it on Check your email.

entries.name: Check your email
entries.say: If an account exists for that address, we've sent a code.
entries.avoid: Saying the account is missing.
entries.note: Show the email they typed. Six boxes take the code. Continue waits until all six are in. Didn't get it is Resend email. Do not put Change email address or Back to sign in on this card. After Resend, New reset email sent. Sign-up uses We've sent a code to the address. Do not store the code.

entries.name: Continue
entries.note: On Check your email. Waits until the six-digit code is in. Disabled is grey, not a faded colour. Do not store the code.

entries.name: Create a new password
entries.note: Continue on Check your email opens this. Rules sit under New password and tick live. At least 8 characters, one uppercase letter, one number, one special character. Confirm password ticks Passwords match when it matches. Reset password waits until they match. Do not store the password or the code.

entries.name: Password updated
entries.note: Helper is Your password has been reset successfully. Sign in is the CTA. It does not skip Sign in. If they came from an invite Sign in, Sign in takes them back to join.

entries.name: You've been invited
entries.note: The invite email. Helper names who invited them and the team. Join the team opens the landing. This invitation expires in 7 days. This invite was sent to the address.

entries.name: Join the team
entries.note: The CTA on the invite email. Opens Review invitation.

entries.name: Accept invite
entries.note: On the invite landing. A new person then creates an account. Already have an account is Sign in.

entries.name: Create your account
entries.note: Helper is You're joining the team. Email address is locked. First name, Last name, Create password. Create account and join waits until the names are in and the password rules tick. Do not store the password.

entries.name: You're in
entries.avoid: IMServ Energy Portal
entries.note: Helper names the team, the company if it differs, and the role. Go to the team opens the product. Do not invent Portfolio Manager or Finance User.

entries.name: This invitation has expired
entries.note: CTA is Request a new invite. After that, Ask an Admin to send another invite.

entries.name: You've already joined this team
entries.note: CTA is Go to the team.

entries.name: Switch account
entries.note: Wrong signed-in account. Heading is This invite was sent to, then the address. Switch account opens Sign in with that email locked.

entries.name: Send invite
entries.note: The modal submit on Users. It stays off until an email is valid.

entries.name: Role
entries.avoid: Super user. User. Admin as a role name.
entries.note: Admin, Manager, Contributor, or Viewer on the customer Users list. Broker / TPI only gets Viewer. Viewer can look. Permission user groups stay in admin.

entries.name: Last active
entries.avoid: Inventing a date they have not been seen.
entries.note: On the person. Not on the Users table. Now for you. Invited until they join.

entries.name: Expiry
entries.avoid: A red fill.
entries.note: On Users. The pill is how long is left. Years if more than 12 months. Months if a month or more. Days if under a month. Admin and Super admin can Renew. Upload a PDF. Start and end use the date calendar. Future days are on. They can only see data between those dates. Manager looks. This walk uses the named contract dates until they renew.

entries.name: Renew
entries.note: On the person. Admin and Super admin. Opens Renew access. Manager looks.

entries.name: Renew access
entries.avoid: Grant access.
entries.note: The modal on Expiry. Upload a PDF. Enter the start and the end as dd/mm/yyyy. They type from the left. They can only see data between those dates. Renew access waits until the file and both dates are there. Disabled is grey, not a faded colour.

entries.name: Upload contract
entries.note: On Renew access. A PDF. Use a PDF if the file is the wrong kind. Do not store the file in this walk, only the name.

entries.name: Replace file
entries.avoid: Change file. Upload again. Re-upload.
entries.note: On Expiry, next to the PDF download. Admin and Super admin. A PDF. Use a PDF if the file is the wrong kind. Dates stay. Manager looks.

entries.name: Start
entries.avoid: From as the field. A native date control.
entries.note: On Renew access. dd/mm/yyyy. They type from the left.

entries.name: End
entries.avoid: To as the field. A native date control.
entries.note: On Renew access. dd/mm/yyyy. They type from the left.

entries.name: Sites they can see
entries.avoid: Sites as the field label. Treating Dummy site A as a named estate. Grant access.
entries.note: On the person. A Select with search. They pick which sites this person can see. They can pick more than one. Ticks. All sites until they take some off. Dummy sites stay on the tree to test Filter.

entries.name: Filter
entries.avoid: All roles as the control. A native dropdown.
entries.note: The role filter on Users. A Filter icon. Overlay uses ticks. The count is a cyan circle. No black rim. Pills sit under Search and Filter.

entries.name: Export
entries.avoid: Excel.
entries.note: The people list extract on Users. An icon. Hover for Export. Pick CSV or PDF. Same as the download on a group or a site.

entries.name: Export
entries.avoid: Export CSV as the only action. Excel.
entries.note: The download on a group or a site. An icon. Hover for Export. Pick CSV or PDF. A banner floats under the nav, in the middle. A 1px Infra Grey B outline. It goes after 10 seconds. View downloads opens Downloads. Not the outgoing channel.
entries.from: Shaun on the export control, 5 Sep

entries.name: Report
entries.avoid: Excel. Add a custom report on the customer side.
entries.note: IMSERV Super admin sets reports up. Customer Admin and Manager only edit Clockwork email. Settings is the cog. It sits on the report card, and next to Download on a Report in Downloads. People, Occurrence, and Starts on sit there. Occurrence is Weekly, Monthly, or Quarterly. Starts on is dd/mm/yyyy. A calendar overlay picks the day. The month sits at the top. Today has a mark. Files sit on Downloads. Live is People are sent this report. The card shows how long is left until the next send. Months if a month or more. Weeks if a week or more. Days if under a week. Waiting is This report is not in yet. You cannot run it. Custom is a name only. You cannot run it yet.

entries.name: Icon tooltip
entries.note: An icon button has a tooltip. Hover for the action. It waits 0.7 seconds. The tip sits outside the control, over the page, so a card does not clip it. Export. Download. Filter. Account. Clear. More. Previous month. Next month. Previous. Next. Resolve. Comment. Close. Help. Settings. The report status tag also explains on hover.

entries.name: Report status
entries.note: The tag on a report card. It sits top right. A long name wraps. The tag stays. Hover for the meaning. It waits 0.7 seconds. The tip sits outside the control. Live is People are sent this report. Waiting is This report is not in yet. You cannot run it. Custom is A name only. You cannot run it yet. A live report shows how long is left until the next send. Months if a month or more. Weeks if a week or more. Days if under a week. Settings is the cog. It sits on the report card, and next to Download on a Report in Downloads. Clockwork email is People, Occurrence, and Starts on. The switch sits on the right, under a line. It waits until Live. Off is the 1px Infra Grey B edge and a black circle. Disabled is grey, not a faded colour. The bar turns the switch when it is Live. Hover shows a pointer. On is the cyan fill and a white circle. No black rim. The circle slides. The fill follows.

entries.name: CSV
entries.note: One way to take the interval view. This walk stays UTC. Outgoing stays positive. Pick queues processing. Download sits on Downloads. Local time waits as an extract setting.
entries.from: Energy manager journey and Shaun on export, 5 Sep

entries.name: PDF
entries.note: The other named extract. Clockwork email stays on Reports. Pick queues processing. Download sits on Downloads.
entries.from: Energy manager journey and Shaun on export, 5 Sep

entries.name: Processing
entries.avoid: Ready.
entries.note: Used on the Export banner and as a Downloads filter. The ready row uses Complete in Tag. Do not invent a status colour.

entries.name: Downloads
entries.avoid: My Documents. Using Downloads as the name of Report.
entries.note: A subpage from Reports. CSV and PDF from Export wait here. Keep My Documents off this pile.
entries.from: Shaun on export processing, 8 Sep, and handoff model, 22 Sep

entries.name: View downloads
entries.note: On the Export processing banner. Opens Downloads. Hide puts that banner away.

entries.name: Your CSV is processing
entries.note: The banner after they pick CSV. It floats under the nav, in the middle. A 1px Infra Grey B outline. It goes after 10 seconds. View downloads opens Downloads.

entries.name: Your PDF is processing
entries.note: The banner after they pick PDF. It floats under the nav, in the middle. A 1px Infra Grey B outline. It goes after 10 seconds. View downloads opens Downloads.

entries.name: No downloads yet
entries.note: The empty Downloads page.

entries.name: Search downloads
entries.note: On Downloads. Filter sits to the right. A cross clears the query.

entries.name: No downloads match
entries.note: Downloads when Search or Filter leaves the list empty. The empty page is still No downloads yet.

entries.name: Download
entries.avoid: Excel.
entries.note: Takes the CSV or PDF from Downloads once it is ready. It sits as a Button on the row. In this walk it plays a short dummy of the cyan bar, then Complete, then the file. CSV from this walk stays UTC. Local time waits as a report or export setting. Daylight saving can show the same local clock twice. Keep both rows.

entries.name: Time left
entries.avoid: Ready. ETA.
entries.note: On the Downloads Status cell while the file is processing. Minutes if a minute or more. Seconds if under a minute. 1 minute left. 1 second left. A cyan bar sits above the line and fills while it waits. Download waits until it is ready. Complete sits in Tag when it is ready. Do not invent a status colour.

entries.name: Complete
entries.avoid: Ready.
entries.note: On the Downloads Status cell when the file is ready. It sits in Tag. Download sits as an Icon button on the row. Hover for Download. Settings sits next to it on a Report. Do not invent a status colour.

entries.name: Queries
entries.note: A tab on a group or a site. The Queries page still holds the full list.

entries.name: Raise a query
entries.note: A small panel sits next to the graph point. Stay on the graph. Title is Query. If Astral sent the first alert, the title is Alert. Close sits on the right. The time and the reading sit in a card. The time is UTC. Do not put a UTC or BST control on the graph. The time, tags, Analyse, and Add tag sit on one row at the top of the card. Analyse drills into that period. The site, meters, and filters stay. Readings fill the width below. Overlay uses Search, Current tags, Recent tags, and the Switch. Create a tag from the search. Tags sit as Tag pills. Each name gets an assigned colour from the IBM Carbon categorical set. That name keeps the colour. Type is black or white for contrast. Not a status colour. A tag stays on that reading when they leave and come back. Peak, On peak, and Out of hours are Time of use, not tags. Groups still wait. Do not put tags in Settings. Do not pick a tag to list every reading. Reports on tagged data wait. In and Out stack in pills with a circle and an arrow, same as the graph key. A stacked bar uses one line per site, meter, or hours slice in that point. Colour matches the graph. Hover uses the same lines. Colour, then the meter or site, then the reading. The hover overlay sits 4px above the bar, same as the pin. A Query or Alert tag sits on that overlay when the point has one. Hover and the pin list the first seven. The rest sit as +17 more sites, groups, or MPANs on a site when Country is England. Click it for the complete list. The list scrolls. Colour matches the stack. Hide puts the extra rows away. A group comparison stacks those groups, not every site. The reading and the unit stay on one line. Estimated sits as Tag on that reading. Not on the whole time. Actual stays unmarked. A reading uses at most one decimal. A whole number stays a whole number. If that time has an alert, Astral sits like a person. The picture is the star from the graph. Cyan on black. Name, and how long ago. The warning is the named kind and the summary. On a thread it sits first. Do not put Astral in Users. The pin sits on the app, under the top nav. Its bottom edge sits 4px above the bar. Drag it to see the graph. Click the point again and it goes back. The picked time uses the 2px black focus edge around the bar. Comment sits at the bottom. The picture sits to the left of the box. Send waits until they type. Disabled send is grey, not a faded colour. Enter raises it. More lines grow it. No resize handle. On a group, raise on the collective. Do not ask which site.

entries.name: 17 more sites
entries.avoid: listing every site on hover
entries.note: Hover and the pin use the same list. Plus then the count. First seven stay. The rest sit as +17 more sites, groups, or MPANs on a site when Country is England. Click it for the complete list. The list scrolls. Colour matches the stack. Hide puts the extra rows away. A group comparison stacks those groups, not every site.

entries.name: What is the query
entries.note: The subject of the query. Off the pin for now. The comment and the reading carry it.

entries.name: Add tag
entries.avoid: Tag as a verb on its own. A pink fill. Untitled group. Tags in Settings. A list of every reading with that tag. A tagged report.
entries.note: On the right of the reading card, next to Analyse. Overlay uses Search, Current tags, Recent tags, and the Switch. Create a tag from the search. Tags sit as Tag pills. Each name gets an assigned colour from the IBM Carbon categorical set. That name keeps the colour. Type is black or white for contrast. Not a status colour. A tag stays on that reading when they leave and come back. Peak, On peak, and Out of hours are Time of use, not tags. Hours names are not tags. Groups still wait. Do not put tags in Settings. Do not pick a tag to list every reading. Reports on tagged data wait. Viewer can look. They cannot add a tag.
entries.from: Shaun on the query pin, 11 Sep

entries.name: Analyse
entries.avoid: Analyze. Investigate. Zoom in as the button name. A magnifying glass on Search.
entries.note: On the query pin, left of Add tag. A magnifying-glass Icon button. Hover for Analyse. It waits 0.7 seconds. It drills into that period. Last 12 months opens that month. A month opens that day. A day is already half-hourly, so the action hides. The site, meters, utility, and other filters stay. Do not use Investigate. That opens an alert on the graph. Analyse is the way into a day from Last 12 months. Do not put 365 days on one graph until a test says the hit target works.

entries.name: Find or create a tag
entries.note: Search in the Add tag overlay. Enter creates the name if it is new, or attaches it if it already exists. Peak is Time of use, not a tag. Do not put tags in Settings. Do not pick a tag to list every reading. Reports on tagged data wait.
entries.from: Shaun on the query pin, 11 Sep

entries.name: Current tags
entries.note: Tags on this reading. The Switch takes one off.
entries.from: Shaun on the query pin, 11 Sep

entries.name: Recent tags
entries.avoid: Untitled group.
entries.note: Named tags they can attach. Names they have used sit here. Do not put Peak, On peak, or Out of hours here. Those are Time of use. Groups still wait. Do not put tags in Settings. Do not pick a tag to list every reading. Reports on tagged data wait.
entries.from: Shaun on the query pin, 11 Sep

entries.name: Comment
entries.note: The thread on a query. Sit it on the reading. Title is Query. If Astral sent the first alert, the title is Alert. Resolve and Close sit on the right. Each comment is a person. Picture, name, and how long ago. If that time has an alert, Astral sits first like a person. The picture is the star from the graph. Cyan on black. Name, and how long ago. Do not put Astral in Users. Meatball on your comment. No outline on the icon. Edit your own. The picture sits to the left of the box. Comment sits at the bottom. Send waits until they type. Disabled send is grey, not a faded colour. On the list it shares one line with the query. Truncate the rest.

entries.name: Astral
entries.avoid: Ask Astral. Putting Astral in Users.
entries.note: On an alert in the pin. The picture is the star from the graph. Cyan on black. Name, and how long ago. The warning is the named kind and the summary. On a thread it sits first. Do not put Astral in Users.
entries.from: Shaun on the query pin, 5 Sep

entries.name: Edit
entries.note: On your comment. Meatball to the right. No outline on the icon. Each comment is its own section.

entries.name: Raised by
entries.note: Who pointed it out. The picture sits in Raised by. Hover for the name. It waits 0.7 seconds. You for the signed in super user. A picture if they have one. An invited person shows as their email until they join. The heading stays on one line.

entries.name: Raised
entries.note: How long ago. Just now if it is under a minute. Then mins, days, months, or years ago. Own column on the list.
entries.from: Shaun on the query list, 5 Sep

entries.name: Acknowledge
entries.avoid: Acknowledged
entries.note: Do not use Acknowledged on the alert card. The word is Unread or Resolved. A tick sits bottom right. Hover for Resolve. After resolve, Undo puts it back.

entries.name: Investigate
entries.note: Opens the graph point for that alert. Highlight it, and show the overlay. If that time has an alert, Astral sits like a person. The warning is the named kind and the summary. On a resolved card the same action is View alert.
entries.from: Shaun on the alert list, 6 Sep

entries.name: View alert
entries.avoid: Investigate on a resolved card.
entries.note: On a resolved alert card. Opens the graph point, same as Investigate. View alerts in Notifications still opens the Alerts list.

entries.name: Undo
entries.avoid: Unresolve.
entries.note: Icon button on a resolved alert. Hover for Undo. Puts the card back with the unread filters.

entries.name: Unread
entries.note: The alert card when it is not resolved. All, Missing data, Not sending, and Odd use on Alerts show unread cards. On a group or a site the Alerts tab is unread. Resolved cards sit on Alerts.
entries.from: Shaun on the alert list, 6 Sep

entries.name: Resolved
entries.avoid: Acknowledged
entries.note: The alert card when it is resolved. Sits in the filters at the top of the Alerts list. All, Missing data, Not sending, and Odd use are unread.
